about: The fixed sentences a local model may select for its answer (DEC-119), read by auditex.answer_digest and auditex.answer_checks.
The model never writes a sentence: per item it selects ids from that item's bank, for the run it selects run frame ids and item numbers.
A frame states only what its precondition makes true; every precondition is checked on the rule facts of the digest, never on model text.

Item preconditions: verdicts (the rule verdict is one of them), severity (the catalogue severity is one of them), has (the item holds these values), catalogue (the item's bank holds a sentence of this name). shows: values Auditex renders, quoted, when the frame is used.
Run preconditions: min and max over the counts checks, not_met, met, not_assessed, not_applicable and shall_not_met; a run frame's {count} placeholders are filled by Auditex.
catalogue: the verdicts for which the item's bank holds its baseline requirement and its baseline remediation steps (from the shipped explainer template).

Rules for a change: no tenant text, plain ASCII, no digit, each text closed by a full stop (a heading by a colon), a precondition that makes the text true for every item it admits, and a review; tests/test_answer_checks.py checks the file.

item.text: Auditex could not assess this check.

The baseline makes this requirement mandatory (SHALL).

The baseline instructions give the steps to meet this requirement.
The rule's reason for this verdict is shown below.
The setting Auditex read is shown below.

Checks that are not met come first, the most severe first.
